head.title: gh-ascii — your GitHub profile as ASCII

meta.name: description
meta.content: Turn any GitHub handle into a neofetch-style ASCII profile card (SVG) for your profile README. The avatar becomes ASCII art and the stats come live from the GitHub API — no hosting, no API key.

meta.name: keywords
meta.content: github profile readme,ascii art generator,neofetch,profile readme generator,github stats card,ascii profile card
gh-ascii — your GitHub profile as ASCII
Turn any GitHub handle into a neofetch-style ASCII profile card (SVG) for your profile README. The avatar becomes ASCII art and the stats come live from the GitHub API — no hosting, no API key.

div.class: mx-auto flex h-14 w-full max-w-5xl items-center justify-between px-6

a.class: gh-star-badge flex h-8 items-center gap-2 border px-3 font-mono text-xs transition-colors hover:bg-accent

main.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-1 flex-col items-center px-6 py-16

div.p: Avatar or custom image and live stats rendered into a neofetch-style SVG card for your profile README.

div.dt: How do I add ASCII art to my GitHub profile README?
div.dd: Enter your handle above and download dark_mode.svg and light_mode.svg. Commit both to your profile repo (github.com/<you>/<you>) next to the README, then reference them from a <picture> element so each theme loads the matching card.

A committed SVG is a snapshot, so stars, followers and uptime drift. The repo ships a drop-in GitHub Actions workflow that re-downloads both themes on a daily cron and commits only when the card actually changed.

div.dt: Do I need to host anything or add an API key?
div.dd: No. The SVGs live in your own repository as plain files, so your README makes no external requests, and the stats are read from the public GitHub API when the card is generated.

div.dt: Can I use my own image instead of my GitHub avatar?
div.dd: Yes. Point the card at any public image URL or upload a file, and turn the background cutout off if you want to keep the original background instead of isolating the subject.

section.p: Source, setup details and the refresh workflow live in the gh-ascii repository.

div.class: mx-auto flex h-12 w-full max-w-5xl items-center justify-between px-6
div.span: avatar or custom image → ascii · stats via github api
